title: Phenomenon lines up in triangles or threes

tellings.quote: and two I have multiple videos and and if we go skywatching at some point you'll see the phenomenon will always try to line up in a triangle or in threes.

plain: Unexplained lights in the sky always try to line up in a triangle or in groups of three, according to Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him and who has been studied by NASA scientists. Bledsoe says he has many videos of this from his skywatching nights, starting around 2012, and tells Michels he will see it for himself if they go out watching together.
